title: plan-proposal (RAW planner-result wrapper, model-emitted)
description: The planner-result wrapper (P0-5): lets a multi-task goal fail cleanly at validation. What Codex emits from planner_create_plan. RAW: FORBIDS authoritative fields (run_id, base_commit, plan_version, hashes). status is READY_FOR_EXECUTION (clean plan) | NEEDS_USER_INPUT (open questions) | BLOCKED. The plan (when status=READY_FOR_EXECUTION) is a strict SINGLE-task plan WITHOUT base_commit/run_id — the engine injects those into the FINAL plan-envelope. (Task 2.1, P0-5, parallel P0-4.) STRICT-MODE (AF-7/R2-1): codex response_format uses strict-mode structured outputs, which require every object's `required` to list ALL its properties (no optional fields) + additionalProperties:false. The wrapper is therefore a fixed-key envelope: status/plan/questions/block_reason are ALL always present; plan is null unless status=READY_FOR_EXECUTION; questions is [] unless status=NEEDS_USER_INPUT; block_reason is "" unless status=BLOCKED. The engine's wrapper-status cross-field rules (schemas.validate_raw_plan) enforce the per-status semantics on top of this structural envelope.

plan.description: The single-task plan. REQUIRED to be present (strict-mode), but null unless status=READY_FOR_EXECUTION (the wrapper-status rules enforce non-null plan only for READY_FOR_EXECUTION). type:[object,null] keeps it structurally valid in all three status branches.

questions.description: Open questions; [] unless status=NEEDS_USER_INPUT (wrapper-status rules enforce non-empty for NEEDS_USER_INPUT).

block_reason.description: Why the goal is BLOCKED; "" unless status=BLOCKED (wrapper-status rules enforce non-empty for BLOCKED).

taskId.description: task id: T000 / T000-R0 form (inlined from spec-envelope so this RAW schema is self-contained — model-API response_format validators do not resolve cross-file $ref).

rawTask.description: Single task as the model emits it — NO base_commit/run_id (engine injects).

verificationCommand.description: Structured verification command (P1-5): NOT an arbitrary shell string. kind chooses the execution path; program is exec'd (or interpreted for script kinds).
